findings.rule: Dependency rule / type-only imports count (shared contract imports infrastructure row type)
findings.explanation: The domain-layer shared contract imports the Drizzle row type ReportRunRow from modules/reports/repository and embeds it in ReportDetailDto (latestRun). vendor/shared is mirrored into client/, so this couples the shared, client-synced surface to server infrastructure and breaks the mirror the moment it is synced; import type does not exempt it (SKILL rules 1 and 9). It also bypasses Zod: ReportDetailDto is a hand-written interface naming a server type instead of a z.infer-derived shape.
findings.fix: Delete the repository import; define the latestRun shape as a Zod schema in the contract (e.g. reportRunSummarySchema with only the fields the wire needs) and derive ReportDetailDto via z.infer from a reportDetailSchema.

findings.rule: Map at the boundary (raw Drizzle row escapes to HTTP)
findings.explanation: toReportDetailDto spreads the raw ReportRunRow into the DTO as latestRun without any row-to-DTO conversion, and the detail route returns it unvalidated, so internal columns (workspaceId, etc.) leak straight to the wire (SKILL rule 5).
findings.fix: Add a row-to-DTO mapper in helpers.ts that converts the ReportRunRow to the contract's Zod-defined latestRun shape before it is placed in ReportDetailDto.
